query:
INSERT INTO ledger_entries
             (id, wallet_id, payment_intent_id, entry_type, amount_cents,
              currency, balance_after_cents, description)
           SELECT $1, w.id, $2, 'debit', $3, $4,
                  (w.balance_cents - $3), 'Purchase payment'
           FROM wallets w
           WHERE w.user_id = $5
